name: vote_stv
description: Count a single transferable vote election with the Droop quota and Gregory fractional surplus transfers in exact fractions: every round's tallies, transfer values, exhausted votes, elections and exclusions, with a stated tie rule (fewest first preferences, then earlier rounds, then a lot order you supply).

seats.description: Seats to fill; fewer than the candidates

ballots.description: Each a strict ranking (list of names, may stop early) or {ranking, count}

candidates.description: Every candidate, including any no ballot ranks; default the names on the ballots

tie_order.description: Order in which candidates lose a tie the counts cannot break (e.g. a drawing of lots); default the reverse candidate order

catalog.source: original; weighted inclusive Gregory method as in the Scottish Local Government Elections Order 2007 (transfer value = surplus x value / votes), without its five-decimal truncation; checked against Wikipedia's Single transferable vote example
